instruction: I want to erase all Amazon-related cookies from Chrome to protect my privacy. Please remove them completely.

metadata.explanation: Task requires erasing Amazon cookies for privacy. Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: The is_cookie_deleted metric uses compare_urls() to match cookie domains, but compare_urls() is designed for full URL comparison, not domain-only strings
Cookie domains in Chrome's SQLite database start with '.' (e.g., '.amazon.com') to indicate subdomain matching, but compare_urls() will fail when parsing domains with leading dots as URLs
The compare_urls() function calls urlparse('http://.amazon.com') which creates an invalid URL structure - leading dots in domains break URL parsing
Semantic mismatch: Using a URL comparison function (designed for 'http://www.example.com/path') to compare domain strings (e.g., '.amazon.com') is logically incorrect
The verification logic will likely produce incorrect results or errors at runtime due to this URL/domain type mismatch
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace compare_urls() with simple domain string matching: check if cookie_domain contains 'amazon.com' or ends with 'amazon.com'
Alternative: Strip leading '.' from both expected and actual domains, then use simple string equality or substring matching
Alternative: Use proper domain matching logic that handles cookie domain format (with leading '.') correctly
The getter (get_cookie_data) and postconfig are correct - only the metric's comparison logic needs fixing
